name: Qube Browser 0.5.1
notes:
0.5.1
Fixed:
* Updates no longer fail right after you press Update

0.5.0
New:
* Notes: text notes and whiteboards, as tabs and in the Library
* Command bar with 60 commands, and Ask AI
* Qube Spark: chat with Claude or ChatGPT
* Streaming Space: a Space with a tile per streaming service
* Little Qube: links from other apps open in a small window
* Spotify as music source, next to Apple Music
* Per profile: search engine, download folder and extensions
* Full keyboard and Narrator support
* Settings in the Windows 11 style
* Works on PCs without a graphics card, such as Windows 365 Cloud PCs

Improved:
* Tabs not used for an hour are unloaded to save memory
* Windows from your last session reopen at start

Fixed:
* Permission questions and page dialogs no longer get lost
* A tab moved to another Space right after opening keeps its page
summary: Notes, a new command bar, a Streaming Space, and support for PCs without a graphics card.

mac.name: Qube for Mac 0.9.5
mac.notes:
New:

* A site's notification puts a red dot on its tab's icon until you open it, runs a streak of light round its Essential, and blinks its Space's button when you are in another Space
* Folders and pinned tabs can stand in any order, and folders can be dragged; an open folder folds while you drag it
* Dragging over the Space's name puts a tab at the top of the pinned tabs

Changed:

* Peek grows from the link you clicked and shrinks back to it when it closes
* Replace Current Tab waits for the page to draw, then the Peek fades over it; Split happens in one go
* Escape closes a Peek again, and the keyboard is back on the page after a Peek closes or opens as a tab
* A path typed or pasted in the command bar opens the file
* The active Essential's coloured rim is half a point wider

Fixed:

* A short notification sound no longer brings up the mini player or music notes
* The main window no longer turns white when a page in another window opens a link in a new tab
* A tab dragged past a folder no longer ends up inside it
* Dragging a folder no longer leaves a huge empty space: it moves just like a tab
* Sites with only an SVG icon show their icon
mac.summary: Smoother Peeks, notifications you can see in the sidebar, and folders that move like Arc's.
